COLUMN CROPS: the split is clean on every page; each c2 crop carries a sliver of the left column's line-ends at its left edge (overlap, not a slice) and each c1 crop shows the first digit of the folio at its right edge; both ignored. Items that run across the gutter: 81 (statements in p32-c1, code and options at the top of p32-c2), 90 (stem at the foot of p36-c1, statements and options at the top of p36-c2), 93 (stem at the foot of p38-c1, options at the top of p38-c2); each was joined in reading order.
